title: Nourishing Italian Cheese Cacio E Pepe
description: A paleo-friendly Italian dish featuring full fat sour cream and kombu-cold-extract, served on a wooden board.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, combine the full fat sour cream, kombu-cold-extract, parmesan cheese, black pepper, and sea salt.
Heat the skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the skillet, tossing to combine with the cheese sauce.
Drizzle the extra virgin olive oil over the top of the spaghetti and toss to combine.
Transfer the spaghetti to a wooden board and top with chopped fresh parsley.
Garnish with additional parmesan cheese and black pepper if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
